title: The Bell of Old Chapel Road
author: Coral Eastwick
blurb: Rosalind Eastwick, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
